download_cat_toy_dataset: download the diffusers cat toy example dataset to a local directory using snapshot_download
download_dog_dataset: download the diffusers dog example dataset to a local directory using snapshot_download
download_controlnet_images: download ControlNet conditioning images from the huggingface documentation repository using hf_hub_download
run_download_all_datasets: run the script to download all training datasets including cat, dog, and ControlNet examples
cleanup_cache_directories: remove .cache directories after downloading datasets to free up disk space
